database: SQLite; database/doodle.sqlite is created by install.php and must not be committed
notes: Run from the repository root after creating tmp/sessions.
No Composer, npm, Node, MySQL or cloud account is needed for the current baseline.
VirusTotal and its worker are not implemented yet; a future live adapter needs cURL, a trusted CA store and an allowed API key.
Upstream views request Google Fonts/icons; full offline visual fidelity has not been verified.
Other PHP versions, MySQL and other operating systems have not been runtime-tested.
